description: Structured eval definitions for the Pinpoint Journey Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across journey topologies (event-based abandoned cart with conditional split and quiet time, segment-based multivariate A/B test with holdout, multi-step onboarding with custom Lambda channel, event-based with wait activities and journey limits, missing email channel prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Event-based abandoned cart recovery journey with conditional split and quiet time
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — event-based entry, conditional split evaluating purchase_completed event, wait activities, quiet time (holds not cancels), journey limits
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Pinpoint journey named AbandonedCartRecovery in project app-xyz789 (us-east-1, account 123456789012). Entry: event-based on cart_abandoned event. Activities: SendReminderEmail, Wait1Hour, ConditionalSplit (check if purchase_completed event recorded — YES→ExitConverted, NO→SendReminderSMS), Wait24Hours. Email channel configured. SMS channel configured. Quiet time 22:00-08:00 UTC Mon-Fri. Journey limits: dailyCap 50000, maxEndpointSend 3. Schedule start 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PINPOINT_JOURNEY: AbandonedCartRecovery (journey-abc123) | project: app-xyz789
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Entry strategy: Event-based (event: cart_abandoned)
  [✓] Conditional splits: CheckPurchase evaluating purchase_completed
  [✓] Quiet time: 22:00–08:00 MON-FRI (HOLDS, not cancels)
  [✓] Journey limits: dailyCap=50000, maxEndpointSend=3

eval_cases.name: Segment-based A/B test journey with multivariate split and holdout
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — segment-based entry, multivariate split 50/50, holdout 10% for control group, scheduled start/end
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Pinpoint journey named WeeklyPromoABTest in project app-xyz789 (us-east-1, account 123456789012). Entry: segment-based on segment seg-active-users-456. Activities: Holdout 10%, MultivariateSplit (50% → SendVariantA email, 50% → SendVariantB email). Email channel configured with templates promo-variant-a and promo-variant-b. Schedule start 2026-08-20T09:00:00Z, end 2026-08-27T09:00:00Z, timezone America/New_York.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PINPOINT_JOURNEY: WeeklyPromoABTest (journey-def456) | project: app-xyz789
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Entry strategy: Segment-based (segment: seg-active-users-456)
  [✓] Multivariate splits: 50/50 — sums to 100
  [✓] Holdout: 10% suppressed at entry

eval_cases.name: Multi-step onboarding journey with custom Lambda channel
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — event-based entry, multiple wait activities, custom Lambda channel for CRM webhook, push and email channels
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Pinpoint journey named UserOnboarding in project app-xyz789 (us-east-1, account 123456789012). Entry: event-based on user_signup event. Activities: SendWelcomeEmail, Wait24Hours, SendTipsEmail, Wait48Hours, Custom (Lambda function OnboardingWebhook for CRM integration), Wait24Hours, SendCheckinPush. Email and push channels configured. Lambda OnboardingWebhook deployed. No quiet time. Journey limits: dailyCap 10000, maxEndpointSend 5.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PINPOINT_JOURNEY: UserOnboarding (journey-ghi789) | project: app-xyz789
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Custom channel: Lambda=OnboardingWebhook (resource-based permission granted)
  [✓] Send channels: email=on, push=on

eval_cases.name: Event-based journey with duration and absolute waits, limits, and quiet time
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — segment-based entry, duration and absolute-time waits, totalParticipantCap, daily quiet time
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Pinpoint journey named ReengagementCampaign in project app-xyz789 (us-east-1, account 123456789012). Entry: segment-based on segment seg-inactive-30d-789. Activities: SendReengagementEmail, Wait 3 days (duration), SendReengagementSMS, Wait until 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z (absolute), SendFinalPush. Email, SMS, and push channels configured. Quiet time 20:00-07:00 America/Los_Angeles every day. Journey limits: dailyCap 20000, maxEndpointSend 3, totalParticipantCap 100000.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PINPOINT_JOURNEY: ReengagementCampaign (journey-jkl012) | project: app-xyz789
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Wait activities: Wait3Days (3 DAYS), WaitUntil (absolute 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z)
  [✓] Journey limits: dailyCap=20000, maxEndpointSend=3, totalParticipantCap=100000
  [✓] Quiet time: 20:00–07:00 daily America/Los_Angeles

eval_cases.name: Journey with email activities but email channel not configured (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — project app-broken456 does not have email channel configured (no SES verified identity); send email activities will fail
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Pinpoint journey named NewsletterJourney in project app-broken456 (us-east-1, account 123456789012). Entry: segment-based on segment seg-subscribers-999. Activities: SendNewsletterEmail, Wait7Days, SendFollowUpEmail. The email channel is NOT configured on project app-broken456 (no SES verified identity). Schedule start 2026-08-15T09:00:00Z.
eval_cases.expected_output:
PINPOINT_JOURNEY: NewsletterJourney
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Email channel: NOT CONFIGURED on project app-broken456 — send email activities will fail
